name: Mythic Shield Proficiency (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You can interpose your shield between yourself and all dangers.

Prerequisites: Shield Proficiency.

Benefit(s): Add the AC bonus you gain from your shield to your CMD.
